products.name: ArrowMake FDM-200
products.shortDesc: Entry-level desktop FDM printer for prototyping, education and small production runs.
products.description: A compact, reliable single-extruder FDM printer built for workshops and small studios getting started with in-house prototyping. Enclosed frame keeps print temperature stable, and the auto-bed-leveling system means less setup time between jobs.

products.name: ArrowMake FDM-500 Pro
products.shortDesc: Dual-extruder large-format FDM printer for bigger parts and multi-material prints.
products.description: Steps up build volume and adds dual extrusion for support material or two-color prints. Suited to architectural models, functional tooling, and larger production parts that outgrow a desktop machine.
specs: PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, PVA

products.name: ArrowMake Resin X1
products.shortDesc: High-detail MSLA resin printer for jewelry, dental models and miniatures.
products.description: Monochrome LCD masking for fast cure times without sacrificing detail. The resolution suits fine-feature work like jewelry casting patterns, dental models, and detailed miniatures where an FDM machine can't keep up on surface finish.

products.name: ArrowMake Industrial 1000
products.shortDesc: Production-scale industrial FDM system for continuous manufacturing use.
products.description: Built for continuous, unattended production runs rather than one-off prototypes. Heated chamber and industrial-grade components target dimensional accuracy and repeatability across long print jobs and engineering-grade materials.

products.name: PLA Filament — 1kg Spool
products.shortDesc: Standard 1.75mm PLA filament, 1kg spool, multiple colors available.
products.description: General-purpose PLA filament for everyday desktop printing. Consistent diameter tolerance for reliable extrusion across common FDM printers.
specs: Black, White, Gold, Grey (select at checkout)
